subject: 2 eggboxes are better than 1!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I understand completely Aaboe! 🙂

When my first Xbox 360 RRod'd It was before they were fixing them for free, so I would have had to pay £80 for a fix. Instead I paid £129.00 for a 2nd box. It was the best purchase I ever made. It wasn't until after I was able to get my dead box fixed for free that I needed to have a 2nd one anyway.. so it all worked out beautifully.

I know what you mean about the long wait for a label, I had to wait a few days for mine too... then had to wait another few days before I was near a printer... then I tried phoning UPS on a Saturday afternoon and they were already closed for the weekend... then I rang on the monday morning and they picked it up the same day. The UPS guy reckoned I would have it back on the Tuesday of the following week, which will be next Tuesday.. we will see.

I'm just glad I still have a working 360 in the house, and I still have my Original Xbox that I can play Burnout 3 online with too! ❤️🎮

subject: Getting some... fun true play time
author: Aaboe
body:
I gotta tell you, bubby, the friend is truly a friend, and actually sort of partner in my company. And my husband would probably look a bit weirdly at me if I used Burnout to get a kiss from someone other than him. 😉

A couple of years ago, when Revenge was newish, we (friend, hubby and me) spent most of a xmas holiday playing it together. Lots of laughs, some gasps and basically a truly fun play time was had by us all. We all felt that we had sort of degenerated into a bunch of 15-year-old kids, non-gender-specific. At the time, I was around 35, and I was the youngest! Now *that* is what Burnout is truly good for... bringing the kid out in you and rejuvenating even the most mature person!

Laters...

Aaboe

subject: If what your sayin' is you
author: bubby flay
body: If what your sayin' is you bought another egg? to"get some " through BurnOut? I gotta laugh at that! and say "good luck" and maybe you will have a good Burnout player to "play" with. I say this because my now ex was an awsome Burner and we had so much fun playin' together. Because you can give each other a fist bump AND a kiss. I probably would have done the same. It's kind of romantic in a geeky gamer kind of way, my props to ya...have fun
